name: Tokyo Station
stampLocation: Marunouchi North Exit, outside ticket gate near the Visitor Center (改札外 丸の内北口JR東日本訪日旅行センター前)
operator: JR East / JR Central / Tokyo Metro
description: Featuring the iconic red-brick Marunouchi Station building designed by Tatsuno Kingo, completed in 1914. The stamp showcases the historic domed facade framed with cherry blossoms.

name: Kyoto Station
stampLocation: Central Gate (Karasuma), outside ticket gates near Midori no Madoguchi (改札外 中央口みどりの窓口横)
operator: JR West / JR Central / Kintetsu / Kyoto Subway
description: The stamp depicts Kyoto Tower towering over the futuristic glass-and-steel atrium of Kyoto Station, with classical Five-Story Pagoda of To-ji in the background.

name: Sapporo Station
stampLocation: West Concourse, outside ticket gate near the Tourist Information Center (改札外 西コンコース北海道さっぽろ観光案内所前)
description: The stamp highlights the historic Sapporo Clock Tower, Hokkaido red foxes, and the JR Tower standing prominently over the northern metropolis.

name: Osaka Station
stampLocation: Bridge Gate Concourse, next to Information Desk (改札外 連絡橋口 案内所横スタンプ台)
description: Portrays Osaka Station City's dramatic diagonal roof, the Grand Front Osaka cityscape, and the energetic water clock plaza.

name: Hakata Station
stampLocation: Hakata Exit Concourse, inside General Information Center (改札外 博多口総合案内所内)
operator: JR Kyushu / JR West / Fukuoka City Subway
description: Features the Hakata Gion Yamakasa festival float with Shinkansen bullet trains and traditional Hakata weaving motifs.

name: Kamakura Station
stampLocation: East Exit ticket office window (改札外 東口みどりの窓口内)
description: Depicts the Great Buddha of Kamakura (Kotoku-in) along with the charming retro Enoden coastal train line.

name: Michi-no-Eki Kyoda
stampLocation: Main Tourism & Product Hall, central stamp table (本館観光案内所・特産品売場中央スタンプコーナー)
description: Japan's inaugural Roadside Station #1 in Okinawa. The stamp illustrates emerald Nago Bay, tropical pineapples, and traditional Shisa lions.

name: Michi-no-Eki Fujikawa
stampLocation: Entrance Lobby, next to Round Information Counter (正面玄関ロビー 情報発信コーナー)
description: A spacious rest facility overlooking the Southern Alps and Mt. Fuji, famous for Koshu yuzu citrus fruit and local Fujikawa river heritage.

name: Michi-no-Eki Aso
stampLocation: Adjacent to JR Aso Station, inside Aso Den-en-kukan Information Desk (館内 総合案内デスク横)
description: Nestled right below Mt. Aso's steaming caldera crater. The stamp features grazing Akaushi brown cattle, volcanic peaks, and fresh jersey dairy motifs.

name: Michi-no-Eki Utoro Shirietoku
name_ja: 道の駅 うとろ・シリエトク
stampLocation: Shiretoko UNESCO Nature Corner, entrance foyer (知床世界遺産案内カウンター前)
description: Gateway to the Shiretoko World Heritage peninsula. Stamp depicts Sea of Okhotsk drift ice (Ryuhyo), brown bears, and Blakiston's fish owls.

name: Ebina Service Area
name_ja: 海老名サービスエリア (EXPASA海老名)
stampLocation: Highway Information Counter, Outbound & Inbound Building 1F (上下線 ハイウェイ情報ターミナル横)
description: Japan's highest-traffic expressway service area on the Tomei Expressway, famous for its record-breaking freshly baked melon pan (melon bread).

name: Ashigara Service Area
name_ja: 足柄サービスエリア (EXPASA足柄)
stampLocation: EXPASA Ashigara Inbound/Outbound Concierge Counter (コンシェルジュカウンター前)
description: Offers breathtaking front-row panoramas of Mt. Fuji, warm footbath cafes, and hot springs for tired travelers driving the Tomei Expressway.

name: Dangozaka Service Area
name_ja: 談合坂サービスエリア (EXPASA談合坂)
stampLocation: Chuo Expressway Information Plaza (中央道ハイウェイ情報コーナー)
description: A favorite mountain rest stop on the Chuo Expressway towards Nagano, celebrated for Hoto noodles, Koshu grapes, and seasonal peach specialties.

name: Himeji Castle
stampLocation: Main Gate Ticket Booth & Himeji Castle Management Office (入城口改札横・管理事務所)
operator: Himeji City / Japan Castle Association (日本城郭協会 100名城 No.59)
description: Known as the 'White Heron Castle' due to its brilliant white plaster walls. UNESCO World Heritage Site and Japan's finest surviving feudal castle complex.

name: Matsumoto Castle
stampLocation: Honmaru Garden Kuromon Gate Ticket Office (本丸庭園内 黒門受付)
operator: Matsumoto City / Japan Castle Association (日本城郭協会 100名城 No.29)
description: The striking 'Crow Castle' with a distinctive 5-tier black wooden keep, built in the late 16th century against the backdrop of the snowy Japanese Alps.

name: Osaka Castle
stampLocation: Main Keep 1F Information Counter (天守閣1階 インフォメーションカウンター)
operator: Osaka Castle Museum / Japan Castle Association (100名城 No.54)
description: Built originally by Toyotomi Hideyoshi, with colossal stone moats and an ornate golden tiger and shachihoko-adorned main donjon.

name: Kumamoto Castle
stampLocation: South Gate Ticket Office & Ninomaru Guide Desk (南口券売所・二の丸案内所)
operator: Kumamoto Castle General Office (100名城 No.92)
description: Constructed by master castle builder Kato Kiyomasa with famous curved stone walls (musha-gaeshi) designed to repel ninja invaders.

name: Sensō-ji Temple
stampLocation: Shado Goshuin Office on the left side of the Main Hall (本堂左側 影向堂朱印所)
description: Tokyo's oldest and most revered Buddhist temple founded in 645 AD. The stamp commemorates the giant red Kaminarimon thunder lantern and Bodhisattva Kannon.

name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
stampLocation: Main Shrine Office & Okusha Shaho Office (本殿授与所・奥社奉拝所)
description: Head shrine of Inari spanning the sacred mountain with 10,000 vivid vermilion Senbon Torii gates and fox messenger statues (kitsune).

name: Itsukushima Shrine
stampLocation: Shrine Exit corridor, Goshuin Office (昇殿口・出口朱印所)
description: UNESCO World Heritage floating shrine built on the Seto Inland Sea by Taira no Kiyomori. The stamp displays the majestic Grand Torii rising out of high tide.
